source.title: Timing and Magnitude of the Male Circumpuberal Growth Acceleration of Height, Weight and Several Facial Dimensions
source.author: Jorge Grau M.
source.institution: University of Oregon School of Dentistry (OHSU digital collections)
source.population: Selected Oregon Child Study Clinic male participants with adequate circumpubertal records

measure: Age at the midpoint of the 6-month interval containing the maximum observed height increment
limitations: Aggregated summary only, no participant-level height histories. Male-only selected historical sample, not representative; not sufficient for trained or validated PHV prediction.
